precision_cache_evidence.finding: Explicit JIT constexpr keyword values enter const_args and entry_key. ALLOW_TF32 is an explicit constexpr for retained MM paths, so true/false select different compiled dispatch keys.

Packed RHS cache does not include precision in the key, but is only queried when current _allow_tf32() and opt-in RNE packing flag are true. FP32 bypasses packed RNE cache. Key includes storage pointer/size, offset, shape/stride, dtype/device, tensor version and stream; insertion retains original tensor to prevent pointer reuse.

Same input tensors are reused for FP32 then TF32 forward/backward and no-grad forward checks. This exercises flag switching for tested shapes, not an exhaustive cache invalidation or special-value test.

limitations: No dedicated tensor-mutation/version-cache device test independently executed by this auditor.
Only locally available source and aggregate results were inspected.
